objective: R72 pickup duplicate-name message cleanup, R73 Firefox-safe drag sources for preset workspace and favorite roster, and R64 admin-managed icons for classification axis options (separate table) shown in filter chips, the character settings dialog and the admin character list.
acceptance_criteria: Step 1 (R72): the shared pickup duplicate-name error no longer says to pick from a list where no list exists; callers that have a list keep their guidance; tests updated.

Step 1 (R73): drag sources in the desktop preset workspace and the favorite roster section start drags from a non-button element (wrapper or dedicated handle) so Firefox and Chromium both drag; click placement and move buttons unchanged.
Step 2 (R64 spec): an English spec under docs/spec defines the icon table, icon format/size limits, admin-only write RLS, option rename/delete cleanup, fallback when unmigrated, and UI placements.

Step 3 (R64 DB): migration adds the classification icon table with admin-only writes and authenticated/anon read matching games visibility, reflected in SCHEMA.sql, database.types.ts, sql/README.md and sql/tests.

Step 4 (R64 UI): admins can set/remove icons per classification option after the template exists; icons render in filter chips, the character settings dialog and the admin character list; unmigrated DB falls back to text only.
Every Maker step passes tsc --noEmit, npm run lint, git diff --check and the full Vitest suite.
